description.text: Core courses Economics, Management, Marketing, Statistic, Chinese Tourism Geography, Hotel Management, Travel Agency Management, Tourism Resource Development and Planning, Tour Guide, Laws and Regulations of Tourism, Chinese History and Culture, Spoken English Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Objective This objective is to train students to be able to do management work in tourism administrative departments, travel agencies and hotels, or do planning, development and management works on tourism spots. In addition, students, after graduation, can work as tour guides in travel agencies, or teachers of tourism education in tourism colleges. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation

duration.text: The Tourism Management at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
